description: The refusal map's probes of base.adventureworks (contract/refusal-maps) on which both core hosts reach describe_source, each with the SHA-256 of describe_source's SourceDescription and, where it starts materialize, of the schema materialize samples (python-core's built from its Schema, rust-host's its own description with the probe's edits made), each as canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace, UTF-8. contract/tests/test_refusal_map.py holds python-core to it and sdm-testkit's tests/refusal_map.rs holds rust-host to it, so CI gates that the two hosts' descriptions are identical wherever both reach describe_source (T1.21d, the AdventureWorks exit); a probe either host reaches describe_source on that the pin does not list, or one it lists that a host does not reach, fails.
